title: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
abstract: arXiv:2610.18638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. translated_title: 对齐还是不对齐：训练之前请先查看你的COMPASS
translated_abstract: 组合预训练模型是构建AI系统的常见策略，无论是将视觉编码器与语言模型对齐，还是合并微调后的检查点。然而，寻找兼容的模型对通常需要昂贵的经验性搜索，因为只有在完成对齐或合并之后才能知道模型之间的兼容性。我们提出了COMPASS（兼容性评估分数），这是一种有理论依据的诊断工具，可以在对齐或合并之前估计模型对是否兼容。基于表征收敛在局部邻域层面最为稳健的观察，COMPASS将模型兼容性分解为两个计算成本低廉的维度：一是特定模型对的容易程度，定义为两个编码器之间的k近邻重叠度；二是范式层面的上限，反映其各自训练范式所允许的最大重叠度。这两个维度共同为候选模型对提供排序，并规定如何针对每一对采取行动：(i) prio（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出COMPASS诊断工具，通过计算两个编码器的k近邻重叠度（模型对容易程度）和训练范式上限两个低成本指标，在训练前即可预测预训练模型对在对齐或合并后是否兼容。
en_tdlr: COMPASS is a theoretically motivated diagnostic that predicts whether a pair of pretrained models will be compatible prior to alignment or merging, by decomposing compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: k-NN overlap (pair-specific ease) and a paradigm-level ceiling.
